 Portland State vs Saint Mary’s Predictions, Picks and Odds | November 16, 2026
 November 16, 2026 at 7:39 am EST by GoldSheet 
 Saint Mary’s has a new head coach, but the same suffocating physicality that has defined Moraga for decades, and now the Gaels are scoring at a pace rarely seen under Randy Bennett. This Portland State vs Saint Mary’s prediction examines whether a completely rebuilt Vikings roster, fresh off a convincing win at San Francisco, can handle the intensity and firepower of a Gaels team averaging 93.5 points per game. 
 Portland State won the Big Sky regular-season title last year, but every starter has since departed, leaving Jase Coburn to start from scratch. Saint Mary’s, meanwhile, has already unnerved UIC and North Dakota State. Before you bet, check out our full slate of college basketball predictions , then dig into the complete breakdown below.
 Quick Picks and Prediction for Portland State vs Saint Mary’s
 Spread Pick: Saint Mary’s -17.5
 Total Pick: Over 149.5
 Projected Final Score: Saint Mary’s 88, Portland State 66

 Saint Mary’s opened as a 17.5-point favorite, briefly moved to -18.5, and has returned to -17.5. The total opened at 150.5 and dipped a point to 149.5. Follow every move through our live odds .

 Portland State vs Saint Mary’s Key Matchups and Handicap
 Portland State Starting Over After a Title Season
 Jase Coburn’s multiyear rebuild at Portland State finally paid off last season, as the Vikings won the Big Sky regular-season championship before being upset by Montana in the conference tournament. Now the process begins again, with every starter gone and Coburn bringing in a new set of faces to the Rose City. Integrating that many newcomers takes time, and facing a program as polished as Saint Mary’s this early is a significant challenge.
 Portland State Win at San Francisco Needs Context
 Things did click on Saturday, when Portland State rolled past San Francisco 84-68 on the Hilltop while shooting 57% from the floor. It was an impressive result on the surface, but it may not be much of a buy signal if the Dons are as downgraded as some WCC insiders suggest. Beating a weakened opponent is very different from handling the Gaels in Moraga.
 PSU Freshman Yaroslav Nikonov Heating Up
 The win over San Francisco was the latest showcase for 6-5 Russian freshman Yaroslav Nikonov, who torched the Dons for 27 points and is averaging 18 points per game. Nikonov gives Portland State a legitimate scoring threat, but he will face far more defensive resistance against a Saint Mary’s team known for its relentless physicality.
 Saint Mary’s Physicality Under Mickey McConnell
 Saint Mary’s is still playing with the same withering physicality that defined the program for the past two decades under Randy Bennett, who moved to Arizona State after last season. First-year head coach Mickey McConnell, a Saint Mary’s alum and Bennett’s former player, has preserved that identity. UIC and North Dakota State have already been unnerved by the Gaels’ intensity and firepower, and it is hard to envision a new-look Portland State roster faring much better.
 SMC Faster Pace and Five Double-Digit Scorers
 McConnell has the Gaels playing at a faster tempo than they did during the Bennett years, and the results have been impressive. Saint Mary’s is scoring 93.5 points per game with five players averaging double figures. The breakout performer has been 6-6 Lithuanian sophomore wing Mantas Juzenas, the latest in a long line of international imports to Moraga, who is averaging 17 points per game.
 Gaels Backcourt: Joshua Dent and Darius Bivins
 The offense still runs through veteran point guard Joshua Dent, who is averaging 15.8 points and 5.8 assists per game. There is also plenty of excitement surrounding freshman guard Darius Bivins, a four-star recruit who scored 20 points in his college debut against an Illinois State team that reached the NIT semifinals last season. That combination of experience and young talent gives Saint Mary’s a dynamic backcourt capable of overwhelming opponents.

 Saint Mary’s is averaging 93.5 points per game.
 Saint Mary’s has five double-digit scorers.
 Saint Mary’s beat Illinois State, UIC, and North Dakota State early this season.
 The spread opened at Saint Mary’s -17.5, briefly reached -18.5, and returned to -17.5.
 The total opened at 150.5 and dipped to 149.5.
 Key Injuries and Notes: PSU vs SMC
 Portland State: No notable absences have been reported heading into this matchup.
 Saint Mary’s: No notable absences have been reported heading into this matchup.
 Coaching Note: Mickey McConnell is in his first season as Saint Mary’s head coach after Randy Bennett left for Arizona State.
 Roster Note: Portland State is integrating an entirely new starting lineup.
 Venue: Moraga, California.
 ATS and Total Picks for Portland State vs Saint Mary’s
 Spread Pick: Saint Mary’s -17.5 
 Saint Mary’s combines its trademark physicality with a faster pace and five double-digit scorers, a dangerous mix for a rebuilt Portland State roster. The Vikings’ win at San Francisco may be less impressive than it appears, and the Gaels have already overwhelmed UIC and North Dakota State. Expect Saint Mary’s to pull away and cover at home.
 Total Pick: Over 149.5 
 The Gaels are scoring 93.5 points per game under McConnell’s more up-tempo approach, and Portland State has shown it can score as well, putting up 84 points at San Francisco. With Saint Mary’s capable of approaching 90 on its own and the total dipping a point from its opener, the Over looks like the right side.
 Portland State vs Saint Mary’s Best Bets
 Best Bet: Saint Mary’s -17.5 (-112)
 Total Bet: Over 149.5 (-115)
 Key Edge: Saint Mary’s physicality and five double-digit scorers against a Portland State roster with no returning starters
 Market Signal: Total dropped from 150.5 to 149.5, offering a better number on the Over
 Final Score Prediction for Portland State vs Saint Mary’s
 Nikonov will provide Portland State with some scoring punch, but Saint Mary’s intensity, depth, and faster tempo should take over in Moraga. Expect Dent, Juzenas, and Bivins to lead a balanced attack that pulls away in the second half, covering the spread while pushing the combined score over the total.
 Projected Final Score: Saint Mary’s 88, Portland State 66
 Spread Pick: Saint Mary’s -17.5
 Total Pick: Over 149.5
